variants.headline: Accident at a workplace
variants.body: An accident has occurred at a workplace in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Workplace safety becomes immediate news

variants.headline: An accident enters the working day
